t: An archipelago of some 17,000 islands, proclaimed independent in 1945 and recognised by the Netherlands after a four-year revolution.
Sukarno's Guided Democracy gave way after the killings of 1965–1966 to Suharto's military-backed New Order.
Since 1998 Indonesia has been a decentralised democracy, a G20 economy and the most populous Muslim-majority country.
dyk: Indonesian, the national language, was chosen in 1928 from Malay, a trading lingua franca, rather than Javanese, the mother tongue of the largest ethnic group.
ev: Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta proclaim independence on 17 August
The Netherlands transfers sovereignty after the Round Table Conference at The Hague
Indonesia hosts the Asian–African Conference at Bandung
A failed coup is followed by the mass killing of alleged communists
Suharto resigns during the Asian financial crisis
First direct presidential election; the Indian Ocean tsunami devastates Aceh
The Helsinki agreement ends the conflict in Aceh
